# @trysac/cron-scheduler-ts

> In-process cron job scheduler for TypeScript: IANA time zones with explicit DST handling, one run per occurrence across instances through a lock port, overlap and catch-up policies TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation and usage example
